From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Manager Orientation: Performance Review & Sensitive Conversation Training

Hi team,

We have a vendor (PeopleOps Training Co.) available to run a 90-minute interactive manager orientation focused on: performance review calibration, delivering difficult feedback, and escalation paths for performance-related HR coordination. They propose running the session the week of Nov 15; I suggested Nov 17 but will confirm based on availability.

Goal for the session: get every new manager a practical playbook and sample scripts/scenarios so they can confidently run mid-year check-ins and escalate when needed. Specific asks from me to the group before the session:
- One or two real but anonymized scenarios we should include (preferably cross-functional or recurring patterns).
- Any must-have policy points to emphasize (e.g., documentation timelines, probation steps).
- Whether we want the session recorded for the Manager Learning Library.

I cc'd Vivek for any compliance/HR constraints and Marissa for linking to the onboarding checklist.

Thanks — please reply with bullets by end of day Wednesday so I can confirm the agenda with the trainer.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior People Lead, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Kimberly,

Thanks — quick notes from the GTM side:
- Please include two scenario types: (1) underperformer with a chronic missed quota but borderline productivity, (2) high-performer with a behavior issue that impacts team dynamics. Both should cover documentation artifacts (emails, 1:1 notes) that managers can use.
- We should reserve ~20 minutes to review how to calibrate ratings across managers — common rubric misunderstandings keep recurring.
- Recording is helpful, but we should mark the recording "internal-use only" and avoid including any actual employee PII.

I can draft anonymized scenario examples if helpful — can share by EOD Wednesday.

Laura
Director, GTM People
Redwood Inference

From: Heather Mills <heather.m@peopleopstrain.com>

Date: 2026-11-02T10:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Manager Orientation: Performance Review & Sensitive Conversation Training — draft agenda attached

Hi Kimberly, Laura, Marissa, Vivek —

Thanks for the brief. Attached is a draft agenda and facilitator notes for the 90-minute session. High level:

1) 10 min — Welcome + quick data on common manager pitfalls
2) 25 min — Role-play: delivering tough feedback (two anonymized scenarios)
3) 20 min — Calibration exercise using a simple 1–5 rubric (we'll use sample anonymized cases)
4) 20 min — Documentation & escalation checklist (what to save, timelines, when to loop HR)
5) 10 min — Q&A + next steps and resources

We recommend an interactive format with breakout rooms for role-play and a short pre-read (manager playbook excerpt) distributed 48 hours in advance. Attached files: manager-orientation-agenda.pdf (facilitator deck), sensitivity-scenarios.docx (sample scenarios).

Two quick clarifications before we finalize:
- Do you have a preferred rubric (we can adapt yours)? If you send it we will use it for the calibration exercise.
- Is there a maximum headcount? Breakouts work best with groups of 6–8.

We can run the live session Nov 17 at 10:00–11:30 PT if that works — otherwise Nov 16 or Nov 18 morning slots are open.

Best,

Heather Mills
Lead Facilitator, PeopleOps Training Co.
onboard@peopleopstrain.com

Attached is our standard evaluation rubric (redwood-eval-rubric.xlsx) — feel free to adapt for the calibration exercise. A couple of internal notes/asks:

- Marissa: we'll want a short follow-up doc (1-pager) with scripts and escalation steps to add to Manager Learning Library; can your team publish within 3 business days of the session?

Thanks all — looking forward. I'll create the calendar invite and share the Zoom + breakout plan once Heather confirms the attendee list.
